thread:
maria_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the rollout approach for the tenant-optin low-latency flag. Customer asks for opt-in per-tenant canaries with regional weighting.
raj_engineering: +1, what's the target metric that will gate expansion?
ana_data: (ana_data) We should gate on p99 latency and error-rate-on-inference. Proposed thresholds: p99 <= 280ms AND error_rate < 0.2% over 5m.
liang_sre: Can we add a safety for KV-cache eviction spikes? Those cause transient p99 blips.
raj_engineering: Good call — include a rolling window that ignores single-minute spikes. Use a 5m median + 10m max check.
maria_pm: Also product constraint: marketing wants a soft A/B for quality signals (human-eval ctl). We need to route ~5% of opt-in traffic to variant B for 2 weeks.
olivia_se: For enterprise customers on Dedicated, they expect an explicit opt-out per-tenant. We should ensure the feature flag supports both global and tenant-scoped toggles.
tim_support: We got one request from AcmeCorp asking for a guaranteed fallback to previous model when hallucination reports > 0.5% per thousand requests. How would that tie in?
raj_engineering: We can wire a fallback policy: if hallucination_rate > threshold, auto-route affected tenants to baseline model variant (v1) and trigger an incident. That needs a quick rollback playbook.
liang_sre: Deploy-bot: can we tag canaries with region and HW class? We want to limit Canary to eu-west1 g4dn first.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued: tag=tenant-optin-canary, region=eu-west1, hw=g4dn, expected-dur=30m
maria_pm: Timeline: MVP rollout to internal tenants next Monday, public opt-in mid-next-quarter if canary stable. Need acceptance criteria spelled out.
raj_engineering: Acceptance criteria draft: - Stable for 72h with p99 <= 280ms and error_rate < 0.2% for canary tenants. - No more than 1 rollback event. - Quality diffs within delta on eval set (talk to ana_data for exact numbers).
ana_data: ana_data: For the A/B quality test, we'll use 5k prompts across 10 prompt families, target significance at p<0.05, delta in intent-preservation > -1.5%. I'll push baseline numbers by EOD.
olivia_se: Also add a migration note: Dedicated customers may have quantized variants; ensure fallback mapping between quantized and full-precision model IDs.
liang_sre: Operational guardrails: - Circuit breaker: global traffic shed to 25% if any region p99 > 600ms for >10m. - Auto-fallback to regional spare capacity if a region crosses 90% GPU util.
maria_pm: Documentation responsibilities: Raj to update runbook, Ana to update eval docs, Olivia to draft customer-facing FAQ.
raj_engineering: For rollout mechanics, propose phased ramp: 0.5% tenant sample -> 2% -> 5% (A/B starts at 5% routing to variant B) -> 20% -> 100%, each step 48h stable window. Can we shorten to 24h for internal tenants?
liang_sre: Internal tenants can have 24h steps, public should be 48h. Also require manual approval at 5% and 20% steps.
maria_pm: Risks: cross-tenant noisy neighbor at 5% if a single tenant heavy. Mitigation: enforce per-tenant caps and burst protection.
tim_support: Add support workflow: if a tenant reports quality regression, support creates a scoped rollback and notifies SRE + PM; we should have a one-click rollback in console.
olivia_se: Customer comms: we need a pre-release email template and a changelog snippet that explains per-tenant opt-in and fallback semantics.
raj_engineering: One more: telemetry hooks — include token-level cost delta, model-id, quantization-tag in trace logs for 30 days. Ana, please confirm that won't blow our quota.
ana_data: ana_data: 30 days is fine if we sample at 10% for full token-trace and aggregate the rest. I'll add sampling rules.
maria_pm: Decisions: 1) Phased ramp with manual approvals at 5%/20% — agreed. 2) Acceptance criteria as drafted — agreed pending Ana numbers. 3) Fallback policy auto-route to baseline if hallucination_rate > 0.5% per 1k reqs — agreed. 4) Per-tenant opt-in with dedicated flag scope — agreed.
liang_sre: Action items: - Raj: implement canary tagging + auto-fallback hooks (owner) - Ana: publish A/B baseline metrics & sampling plan - Olivia: prepare customer FAQ + rollback button spec - Tim: draft support runbook steps - Maria: update launch checklist and stakeholder comms
maria_pm: Meeting wrap: we'll reconvene Friday after Ana's numbers. If anyone hits blockers ping me here. :thumbsup:
tim_support: noted, I'll draft the support playbook now and link it.
raj_engineering: started a draft PR for canary selector. ping me if you want review.
ana_data: pushed baseline evals to /evals/tenant-optin/baseline.csv and QA note in the doc.
liang_sre: I'll schedule a dry-run for the circuit breaker simulation tomorrow 3pm UTC.
maria_pm: thanks all.
notes: short-thread; logistics + acceptance criteria; contains deploy-bot messages and inline file refs
